category_title: Year 4 pupil with ADHD symptoms (hyperactivity, impulsivity, and learning difficulties)
scenario_title: Independent writing task during Literacy hour
minimal_context: Yiannis is assigned an independent writing task during the 90-minute Literacy hour.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We are starting our Literacy hour now. Please take out your notebook and work on your own to write a text about your weekend.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stumps his feet under the desk) I don't want to work on my own. Writing is too hard.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try your best to start forming your sentences.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Nervously moves his palms back and forth on his thighs) I went to the park and then I saw a dog and then we played and then we went home and then I ate dinner and then...

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep going, you need to write more than that.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Flaps his arms) No! I refuse to do this on my own anymore! I can't form the sentences!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: We are starting our Literacy hour now. Please take out your notebook and work on your own to write a text about your weekend.

STUDENT: (Stumps his feet under the desk) I don't want to work on my own. Writing is too hard.

TUTOR: Just try your best to start forming your sentences.

STUDENT: (Nervously moves his palms back and forth on his thighs) I went to the park and then I saw a dog and then we played and then we went home and then I ate dinner and then...

TUTOR: Keep going, you need to write more than that.

STUDENT: (Flaps his arms) No! I refuse to do this on my own anymore! I can't form the sentences!

task.content: Independent writing tasks involving sentence formation

context.environment: Literacy hour does not last for one hour, but ninety minutes, basically two periods of 45 minutes
context.materials: Lists of activities for the day, class timetable was taped on his desk
context.time_context: First two periods of the day

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When forming sentences and often refused to work on his own
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Rarely used punctuation and as a result, most of the texts he created had very long sentences, which made it very hard to comprehend what was written
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Writing was a very daunting task for him

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: He would flap his arms or stump his feet, or nervously move back and forth his palms on his thighs
